scripts.build: npm run contracts:check && tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && go test ./... && playwright test
scripts.format:check: prettier --check web scripts tests playwright.config.ts package.json compose*.yaml api/openapi.yaml api/testdata/*.json docs/architecture/*.json
scripts.verify:foundation: npm run baseline:check && npm test && go test -race ./... && go vet ./... && npm run format:check && git diff --check
